maria-peopleops: @dan quick scan please 441 compact manager checklist for Olivia's first week. Want it minimal and timezone-friendly (Olivia is PST).

dan-eng-manager: thanks! include monorepo access check, a 1hr API walkthrough, pairing session, and a tiny bug/typo to ship by day3. Also 30/60/90 bullets.

maria-peopleops: draft below (copy into invites):

Day0: confirm hardware request, add to #new-hires, submit repo access form
Day1: 10:00 intro + team stand, 13:00 setup (accounts + MDM), 15:00 docs tour
Day2: 09:30 API walkthrough (pair), 14:00 repo clone + test PR
Day3: 10:00 shadow deploy, 14:00 pick tiny bug and ship PR
Day4: 11:00 cross-team sync, 16:00 manager 1:1 (expectations + 30/60/90)
Day5: 11:00 onboarding retro, afternoon wrap + celebrate

Tiny 30/60/90 to hand out:
30d: dev env green, merged a small PR, met key partners
60d: own a small feature and take reviews in area
90d: lead a post-deploy check or ship a perf/infra improvement

Who-to-ask: hardware & MDM = @it-support, repo perms = @eng-infra, security = @sec-ops, benefits = @people-ops.

dan-eng-manager: perfect. I'll shift pairing to 14:00 PST where needed and schedule the bug for Wed PM.

olivia-newhire: thanks! I got the laptop tracking and joined #new-hires. Repo still 403 though. timezone PST.

eng-infra: Hi Olivia 44b please DM your GitHub handle. We'll add perms within the day.

maria-peopleops: done — moved key sessions to overlap hours. Welcome Olivia! :tada:
